scope: P1-A55 current classic Ma Dai, Qianxi rules and official portrait
selectedVersion: 一将成名官网当前经典形象马岱

sources.use: 当前官方武将页：蜀势力4体力、马术，以及准备阶段摸一张、弃一张、选择距离1目标并封禁同色手牌的潜袭；同时提供574x761经典形象大图。
官方历史公告：归档曾使用准备阶段判定的修订版，以及更早在杀造成伤害时改减体力上限的旧版；本块均不采用。
官方历史攻略：交叉核对判定版潜袭的目标、颜色和回合边界，用于明确与当前摸弃版的差异。
潜袭版本发现与经典／界限／国战差异对照。
按用户指定概念页区分锁定标签、状态技与触发技；潜袭同时具有可选时机和回合内持续状态。

ruleText: 准备阶段开始时，你可以摸一张牌然后弃置一张牌。若如此做，你选择距离为1的一名其他角色，然后直到回合结束，该角色不能使用或打出与你以此法弃置的牌颜色相同的手牌。

versionBoundary.replayPolicy: the offer, exact discard, target, color restriction and expiry reconstruct from the accepted command prefix

portrait.attribution: Official classic Ma Dai artwork reused only for the user's local experiment under explicit authorization

assertions: Qianxi opens a private use-or-skip prompt, then exact discard and distance-1 target prompts
red restriction excludes red hand Slashes while preserving black hand Slashes
black restriction excludes black hand Slashes while preserving red hand Slashes
the restriction applies only to hand cards and clears at the next turn boundary
rules v103 and package 1.81.0 preserve the previous boundary
paused offer and color-filtered response replay deterministically
official portrait, both skill texts, discard choices and live color state are visible without clipping

excludedVariants: the older damage-prevention and max-HP-loss version
deferred: real Windows desktop mouse and keyboard acceptance
